brief:
Egyptian engineers and contractors entered Rafah and began taking measurements for planned infrastructure and reconstruction work, according to Israeli military radio. The survey work precedes construction of what Israeli sources call "Green Rafah," a reconstruction initiative expected to begin soon.

The Ma'an news agency reported the development based on Israeli military radio's account of the Egyptian team's arrival and initial assessments in the southern Gaza city.
dek: Egyptian engineers and contractors entered Rafah and began taking measurements for planned infrastructure and reconstruction work, according to Israeli military radio.
title: Egyptian engineers enter Rafah to survey reconstruction project
